title: The Sixth Chess Player
next_chapter_hook: 「We are all three pieces on the board—the only difference is that I awakened ten thousand years earlier.」 The Demonic Path commander's lips parted softly, each word like a blunt blade, repeatedly torturing Chen Ji's carefully constructed worldview of seventeen years.

text.content: The tremor from the depths of his brow center was not pain but something more primal—a sense as if an ancient stone door sealed for millennia had been gently tapped by wind from outside, letting in a sliver of light. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, but his knees remained steady as bedrock. His right hand nonchalantly pressed against the yellowed fragment at his waist. In the first page of the Tianji Record, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled slightly, and an aged voice poured directly into Chen Ji's Mental Sea: 「It's here. Three days earlier than this old man calculated.」

dialogue.content: 「Chen Ji.」 The voice did not originate from the Demonic Path commander's throat but surged simultaneously from the void in all directions, as if thousands of departed souls had spoken the same words in a single instant, 「Seventeen years. I have waited three thousand years.」

text.content: Chen Ji did not respond. His gaze passed beyond the Demonic Path commander's youthful, almost妖异 face, landing on the rolling black mist behind him. Within the mist, countless distorted human silhouettes were faintly visible—the Demonic Path army, several hundred thousand strong, yet now like puppets pulled by invisible strings, not a single soldier daring to cross that boundary of black mist. The entire battlefield fell into an eerie silence, broken only by the mournful wind whistling through broken walls and ruins, resembling sighs from the grave.

dialogue.content: 「What are you looking at?」 The Demonic Path commander stepped forward. Chen Ji clearly saw that the流转 in his eyes was not killing intent, but a near-playful scrutiny, 「Are you looking at your chessboard, or your chess pieces?——Or perhaps you're wondering how much of your original will remains within this borrowed body?」

text.content: A slight arc curved at the corner of Chen Ji's lips—the cowardly mask he always wore to deceive others. However, in the next instant, he suddenly gripped the Tianji Record Fragment tightly. The restriction gap at his brow center expanded abruptly, and a mighty torrent of information burst into his Mental Sea like a breached dam—these were not blurry images, but crystal clear, as if witnessed firsthand: ten thousand years ago, a white jade altar floating above the nine heavens, six figures standing at its six corners, and in the altar's center burned a golden flame sealing something... beyond all his comprehension.

dialogue.content: 「You see it now?」 The Demonic Path commander's voice suddenly dropped low. The playful smile on that youthful face vanished completely, replaced by a desolation spanning ten thousand years, 「That was the scene of Cang Yutian's final deception. Within that golden flame burned fragments of our six fates. He told us that burning the fate fragments was to reshape the Heavenly Dao—but what he didn't say was that after the reshaping completed, we would completely dissipate, and he alone would enjoy the authority of the new Heavenly Dao.」

text.content: Chen Ji felt his back soaked through with cold sweat. Not from fear, but because those images were too real—real enough that he could almost smell the scorching scent from the altar, could feel the excruciating agony as each of those six souls was stripped away. The Tianji Record convulsed wildly in his Mental Sea. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out once more, but carried unprecedented gravity: 「Young master, these are... genuine memory fragments. Someone of immense power sealed them within the cracks of the Tianji Record. What you see now is merely the tip of the iceberg from that alliance ceremony ten thousand years ago.」

dialogue.content: 「You ask why I opposed Cang Yutian.」 The Demonic Path commander stepped forward slowly, black mist forming countless ancient runes around him—those runes resembled yet differed fundamentally from the archaic text Chen Ji had seen on the Tianji Record Fragment—they were written in reverse, deliberately distorted, 「Because his promised 'Reshaping of the Heavenly Dao' was nothing more than a gluttonous feast using all living beings as sacrifice. The oath our six people swore to the heavens was originally 'Share life and death, jointly prove the Great Dao'——but he changed the final character of the oath.」

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Changing that final character—'jointly prove the Great Dao' into 'solely prove the Great Dao'—a single character making a world of difference. He drew a deep breath, forcing himself to remain calm. His seventeen years of strategic experience played a role at this moment: he rapidly constructed a logical chain in his Mental Sea, cross-referencing the fragmented information from the Tianji Record Fragment with the Demonic Path commander's words. Mo Xiansheng had said the Tianji Record was a piece Cang Yutian left for future generations—so what role did this current commander play?

dialogue.content: 「You want to know why I've only appeared now?」 The Demonic Path commander seemed to pierce through Chen Ji's thoughts, a sneer forming at his lips, 「Because I was sealed within the chaotic rift at the Heavenly Realm's boundary. Every millennium, that seal loosens slightly due to the cycle of Heavenly Dao—and what I was waiting for was the awakening of another 'Twin of Destiny'. You think your sister's being taken by the Holy Sect was coincidental? Chen Ji, from the moment you two were born, the Eye of Heavenly Fate already placed you on the chessboard.」

text.content: The name Chen Nian pierced Chen Ji's heart like a sharp blade. His breath caught for a moment, his right hand's knuckles whitening from intense pressure. She was his missing sister of seven years—the untouchable bottom line in all his strategic planning—and now this Demonic Path commander, who claimed to be a chess player from ten thousand years ago, casually invoked her name as if she were a discarded piece. Rage churned in his chest, but Chen Ji knew even more profoundly: a true strong one never reveals weakness before an enemy. He suppressed that surging emotion back into the deepest recesses of his chest, reassembling that harmless, timid smile on his face.

dialogue.content: 「Finished?」 Chen Ji's voice emerged with surprising steadiness, even surprising himself, 「Betrayed by companions ten thousand years ago, sealed for millennia, finally waiting for the awakened Twin of Destiny—it does sound pitiful, truly deserving sympathy. But I have one question: how did you determine I was one of the 'Twin of Destiny'? The Tianji Record never revealed to me who the other party was.」

text.content: The Demonic Path commander came to a halt. On that youthful face, the first expression of near-admiration appeared. 「Good.」 He only spoke this one word, 「Indeed a being that even after Cang Yutian's three thousand years of machinations, he could not completely erase. Maintaining such composed interrogation before this one—if Cang Yutian had possessed even half your depth of cunning back then, he wouldn't have ended up with his current fate of being consumed by Heavenly Fate's will.」

choice.prompt: The Demonic Path commander's words concealed massive amounts of intelligence. Chen Ji needed to choose between continuing to interrogate and verifying authenticity—while his concern for Chen Nian gnawed at him like a thorn, each mention reminding him of seven years of unceasing guilt and fury.

choices.text: 「The 'Eye of Heavenly Fate' you mentioned—what exactly is its relationship with Cang Yutian?」
choices.description: Continuing to probe the genuine relationship between Cang Yutian and the Eye of Heavenly Fate, cross-verifying potential logical inconsistencies in the other party's statements.
choices.risk_hint: The opponent might be using this to probe your cognitive boundaries.

dialogue.content: The Demonic Path commander paused slightly, then let out a low laugh—the laughter carried ten thousand years of vicissitudes and sarcasm: 「Cang Yutian? He was the first vessel for the Eye of Heavenly Fate. What you call the 'Eye of Heavenly Fate' was originally merely a wisp of will fragment that escaped during the collapse of the Heavenly Realm—and Cang Yutian was the first to proactively incorporate it into his body. He thought he was controlling Heavenly Fate, but actually...」

text.content: His words came to an abrupt halt because in that precise instant, the restriction gap at Chen Ji's brow center suddenly expanded massively. A memory not belonging to him slithered into his Mental Sea like a venomous serpent—in that chaotic darkness, he witnessed Cang Yutian, saw a man entangled by countless golden threads. Those threads were not施加 from outside, but grew from within Cang Yutian's own body, each one connected to his divine soul, bones, blood, and meridians. He was struggling, screaming, he was... being devoured.

choices.text: 「Where is Chen Nian. You will give me an answer.」
choices.description: Directly demanding Chen Nian's whereabouts, fury that could no longer be suppressed.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial clues about Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: Expose emotional weaknesses to potential enemies

dialogue.content: "'Chen Nian?' The Demonic Path Commander's voice suddenly softened, the coldness on that youthful face receding, replaced by a complex emotion—seeming like seeing the shadow of an old acquaintance. 'She is at the deepest part of the Holy Sect, at the 'Heavenly Fate Altar,' together with the remnant soul of Cang Yutian. The name 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key'... was given by Cang Yutian.'"

text.content: Chen Ji felt his heart skip a beat at that moment. The Heavenly Fate Altar—he had seen this name in some obscure records of the Tianji Record Fragment, a forbidden land used in ancient times to imprison those with heavenly fate. And Cang Yutian's remnant soul... His fist slowly tightened inside his sleeve, the sharp pain of nails digging into his palm反而让他感到一种病态的清醒。

choices.text: Remain silent, quietly listen to the other party's complete statement.
choices.description: Do not interrupt, do not question, use silence to force the other party to reveal all their cards.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the initiative to pursue questioning
choices.visible_reward: Let the other party expose more flaws and true intentions

dialogue.content: Chen Ji did not speak. He merely lifted his chin slightly, gazing at the Demonic Path Commander with eyes almost bordering on pity. That gaze made the Commander's brow crease almost imperceptibly—he had not been looked at with such 'see-through' eyes for a very long time. 'You don't ask questions?' His tone carried a hint of uncertainty.

text.content: Chen Ji remained silent. He knew that a true chess player, after casting out bait, could endure nothing worse than the opponent's refusal—not the opponent's indifference. Silence is the greatest pressure on a chess player. He gambled correctly—the Demonic Path Commander, after a brief silence, took the initiative to speak, and this time, a subtle urgency crept into his voice: 'You are more difficult to deal with than your father.'

"'My father?' Chen Ji's gaze sharpened abruptly, 'Is Chen Xuan also one of the chess players?' The moment this question left his lips, he mentally recorded this debt—he had exposed his ignorance of his own bloodline's secrets before an enemy, a rare mistake in his seventeen years of scheming. Mo Xiansheng let out a low sigh in his Mental Sea: 'Chen Xuan... is the only one among the third-generation chess players who successfully left a contingency under Cang Yutian's nose. He chose you, not because of your extraordinary talent, but because... you and your sister are the only pair of twin souls in ten thousand years to simultaneously carry fragments of both 'Heavenly Secrets' and 'Heavenly Fate'.'"

dialogue.content: "'So you want cooperation?' Chen Ji's voice regained its calm, but the light in those eyes grew even sharper than before, 'A chess piece sealed for ten thousand years, and a pair of newly awakened destined twins—do you think if we join hands, we can oppose the Heavenly Eye that has already devoured Cang Yutian?'"

"'Not 'think'.' The Demonic Path Commander reached out, black mist condensing into an antique token in his palm—on the token was carved a distorted rune, strikingly similar to the Heavenly Oath mark on the Tianji Record Fragment, yet slashed violently with a crack, 'It's 'know'. Because ten thousand years ago, when Cang Yutian revealed his true form, the first to stand up in opposition—was me. The moment I was sealed, the Heavenly Eye also paid a price. It entered a ten-thousand-year dormancy. And now, it has awakened.'"

text.content: The wind on the battlefield suddenly stopped. The Demonic Path Commander's gaze越过陈机的肩头，看向了他身后的虚空。那里本该空无一物，然而就在下一刻，一道细微的裂缝在那片虚空中无声裂开，一缕金色的光芒从裂缝中泄出，那光芒温润得如同初春的晨曦，却让魔道主帅的脸色瞬间变得惨白。'它已经来了。'他低声说道，声音里第一次出现了真正的忌惮，'比上次更快——陈机，你现在有两个选择。'

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Eye's consciousness has descended, the Demonic Path Commander gave Chen Ji two choices—and that golden crack is slowly expanding, as if something is gazing at everyone on this battlefield from the other side.

choices.text: Accept the token, form a temporary alliance with the Demonic Path Commander
choices.description: Take the token carved with the cracked rune, officially become a member of the alliance against the Heavenly Eye.
choices.visible_cost: Bear the karmic burden of ancient grudges from ten thousand years ago
choices.visible_reward: Gain the Demonic Path Commander's ten-thousand-year strategic intelligence + partially unseal the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: The other party's true intentions have not yet been fully revealed

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate. He reached out and seized the icy-cold token. The moment it touched his palm, a majestic force surged along his meridians straight to his brow center—the Tianji Record Fragment vibrated violently, and on its first page, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul suddenly glowed with a layer of golden light, a sign of unsealing. Meanwhile, a low cold hum came from the golden crack, that sound carried no emotion whatsoever, yet instantly solidified the air within a hundred zhang into substance.

choices.text: Refuse the token, I want to see your sincerity with my own eyes
choices.description: Do not accept an alliance of unknown origin, demand the other party first prove their stance.
choices.visible_cost: Missed the best opportunity to retreat
choices.visible_reward: Forced the Demonic Path Commander to reveal more trump cards
choices.risk_hint: The gaze of the Heavenly Eye will continue to intensify

text.content: Chen Ji's hand hovered steadily in mid-air, yet it did not touch the token. The Demonic Path Commander's gaze shifted slightly; the token in his palm trembled faintly, as if sensing its master's hesitation. "You wish to see sincerity?" His voice was low, "Very well." Before the words even finished, the token exploded into a mass of black mist, and within the mist manifested an image—a deep underground palace, and on the central stone platform lay a person. A woman bearing a striking resemblance to Chen Ji, her eyes tightly closed, with a golden needle inserted at the center of her brow.

dialogue.content: "This is what I glimpsed three days ago using my remaining power." The Demonic Path Commander's voice was soft. "That golden needle is the 'Heavenly Fate Lock' the Heavenly Eye uses to imprison your sister. I cannot remove it—but the complete form of the Tianji Record can."

text.content: Chen Nian's face. Seven years apart, she had grown emaciated, her cheekbones more angular than memory served, though the tightly pressed corners of her lips still held the stubborn shadow of childhood. Chen Ji's breath ceased entirely in that instant; seventeen years of composure fractured at its most critical point—he watched his sister's skin around that golden needle at her brow center decay visibly, as if an invisible venomous spider continuously drew her life force from that needle. The Tianji Record blazed intensely in his palm as Mo Xiansheng's urgent voice rang out: "Young master, that is the 'Heavenly Fate Soul-Devouring Needle'—every seven days it drains a thread of the host's Heavenly Fate power. Your sister's Heavenly Fate value... is nearly exhausted!"

dialogue.content: "So now you believe?" The Demonic Path Commander's voice drifted from within the black mist, carrying a hint of weariness. "The Heavenly Eye never gives anyone a choice. It sets the board, manipulates destiny, turning every person into fuel for its reshaping of heaven's principles—including Cang Yutian, including me, including you, including your sister. All of us, from the moment of birth, have been lambs waiting to be slaughtered on its chessboard."

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes slowly. He said nothing, no questions, not even anger—he was calculating. For seventeen years, countless times in desperate situations he had carved a path forward through such silent contemplation. Yet this time, for the first time, he felt that familiar calculating power trembling beneath fate's crushing weight. Heavenly Fate Lock Key. Tianji Record. Heavenly Eye. Cang Yutian. Chen Nian. All the clues wove together in darkness into an impenetrable net, and he was merely the most insignificant moth caught within it.

"The three of us are all pieces, except I awakened ten thousand years before you." The Demonic Path Commander's lips parted gently, each word like a dull blade, repeatedly torturing Chen Ji's worldview built meticulously over seventeen years. "But there's one thing you must remember—between pieces and pieces, there are ways to live and ways to die. I chose to resist, so I was sealed for ten thousand years. What about you, Chen Ji? Do you choose to continue being Cang Yutian's leftover piece, or do you choose... to be your own chess player?"

The golden fissure expanded silently behind Chen Ji, that dawn-warm light now sending chills down the spine. Chen Ji knew time for contemplation was nearly spent. The Heavenly Eye's consciousness was crossing the fissure, and the Demonic Path Commander's trump cards—the images of Chen Nian, the truth about the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, the secret of the complete Tianji Record—each was enough to overturn the entire careful arrangement he had maintained for seventeen years. His right hand slowly clenched the Tianji Record Fragment, his knuckles trembling slightly from the force. He lifted his head, gazing toward that approaching golden light, the corner of his mouth curving—not the timid smile he habitually showed others, but something far more dangerous, an expression that only appeared when a hunter fixed its gaze on prey.

"I'll be the chess player." Chen Ji's voice was not loud, yet it rang clear as thunder, cleaving the stagnant air of the battlefield. "But not now—not now I need more intelligence." He turned around, for the first time directly facing that golden fissure, his eyes containing no fear, only a nearly cruel calmness. "Since the Heavenly Eye wishes to watch a show, I'll perform for it. Demonic Path Commander, you just said you were sealed for ten thousand years—then I need you to tell me, throughout these ten thousand years, exactly how much... tradable leverage have you accumulated?"
